methodologyNotes: Roster of 10 independently re-verified submersible aquarium heaters spanning entry-level fixed-thermostat glass heaters (Tetra HT30), classic adjustable glass heaters (Eheim Jager 150W, Fluval M150), electronic plastic/glass units (Fluval E300, Aqueon Pro 100W, Cobalt Neo-Therm 100W, Orlushy 300W), and titanium models with external control (Finnex HMA-200S, hygger 500W Titanium), sourced from specialty aquarium retailers and review sites (AquaCave, Bulk Reef Supply, TheHiddenReef, KensFish, BucePlant, EheimSupport, ReptileSupply, ThatPetPlace, ReviewAqua, NationalWPSupply). Every kept product has at least one source that was successfully live-fetched on 2026-08-16. wattage_w is a unitless number; tank_size_range_gal is a string in US gallons; temperature_accuracy_f is a manufacturer-stated tolerance string in °F, left null where only an adjustment/selection increment (not a true accuracy tolerance) was published or where the only source was blocked; boolean specs record a feature only when a source explicitly addressed it, else null. Two candidates were dropped: ISTA Titanium 300W (no confirmed titanium submersible spec sheet — only the inline I-H615 / unverifiable I-H790), and hygger Submersible 300W (both its Amazon and hygger-online.com pages returned server errors / 403 on fetch, leaving no verifiable source for existence, price, or specs). accessedAt 2026-08-16.

products.name: Fluval E300
products.priceNote: AquaCave retail price, verified live 2026-08-16; Fluval's own US store page is bot-protected.
products.provenance: Wattage (300W), 100-gal max tank size, integrated LCD with dual temperature sensors, and glass sleeve with integrated fish guard verified via live fetch of AquaCave's product page ($72.99). temperature_accuracy_f corrected to null: the source states only that temperature is SELECTABLE to the nearest 0.5°F (an adjustment increment) plus a ±2°F color drift alert — no true accuracy tolerance is published (the prior draft's '±0.5°F accuracy' conflated the selection increment with a tolerance). Price is AquaCave retail, not a confirmed Fluval MSRP.

products.name: Eheim Jager 150W
products.priceNote: AquaCave retail price for this long-running model (EheimSupport lists it around $29.99).
products.provenance: Wattage, $39.99 price, 2mm shock-resistant Pyrex glass construction, and explicitly-stated ±0.5°F bistable-thermostat accuracy verified via live fetch of AquaCave; the 53-79 gal (200-300 L) rating and fully-submersible freshwater/saltwater use independently confirmed on EheimSupport's live listing. No source described a built-in shatterproof guard on this bare-glass classic, so shatterproof_guard=false.

products.name: Cobalt Aquatics Neo-Therm 100W
products.priceNote: Bulk Reef Supply's stated regular (non-open-box) price; open-box shows $49.12 and other retailers run higher.
products.provenance: Wattage (100W), 29-gal max tank size, ±0.5°F electronic-thermostat accuracy, shatterproof plastic outer casing, 66-96°F range, and $65.49 regular price all verified via live fetch of Bulk Reef Supply's product page; plastic housing corroborated by AquaCave's Neo-Therm listing.

products.name: Fluval M150
products.provenance: Wattage (150W), up-to-45-gal size, $36.99 price, 66-86°F range, and shock-resistant mirrored borosilicate glass build verified via live fetch of AquaCave's product page. No source published a temperature-accuracy tolerance, so temperature_accuracy_f left null.

products.name: hygger 500W Titanium
products.priceNote: BucePlant retail price (currently sold out); Amazon and Premium Aquatics pricing fluctuates.
products.provenance: Wattage (500W variant), 60-120 gal (270-540 L) tank range, 70-94°F regulation, and $66.99 price verified via live fetch of BucePlant's product page; the Amazon listing title independently confirms '60-120 Gallon' and an 'External IC Thermostat Controller' (external_controller=true). Material kept as titanium per the product identity (hygger 'Titanium Aquarium Heater', TA2 titanium-alloy tube) even though BucePlant's structured spec field mislabels it 'Stainless Steel'. temperature_accuracy_f corrected to null: the prior draft's ±1°F came only from hygger's blocked (403) spec page and cannot be corroborated from any fetchable source. No source confirmed a separate shatterproof guard.

products.name: Aqueon Pro 100W
products.provenance: Full spec set (100W, up to 40 gal, durable shatterproof thermal-plastic housing, ±1°F electronic-thermostat accuracy, 68-88°F adjustable range, fully submersible with auto shut-off) verified via live fetch of TheHiddenReef's product page ($49.99); the up-to-40-gal rating is independently corroborated by ReptileSupply's live listing (title and URL both state 'up to 40 gal').

products.name: Finnex HMA-200S
products.priceNote: Bulk Reef Supply's regular (non-open-box) price; open-box shows $27.19.
products.provenance: Full spec set (200W, titanium tube, ±2°F accuracy from set point, external analog controller mounted on the cord, plastic guard over the heating element, 68-92°F range, ~61-80 gal) verified via live fetch of Bulk Reef Supply's product page ($31.99 regular); the 60-80 gal rating is corroborated by the SaltwaterAquarium.com listing. external_controller=true reflects the HMA line's defining separate-from-tube control unit.

products.name: Marineland Precision 200W
products.provenance: Wattage (200W), $36.97 price, up-to-55-gal rating, submersible status, flattened mesh heating element around a mica core, and an adjustable dial (1°F per click) verified via live fetch of KensFish's product page. Neither source stated the outer-tube material or a true accuracy tolerance (only the 1°F adjustment increment), nor confirmed a shatterproof guard, so material, temperature_accuracy_f, and shatterproof_guard were left null rather than assumed from a generic glass-heater default.

products.name: Orlushy 300W
products.priceNote: No single verified US price for the 300W variant specifically; Orlushy's 100-300W line lists roughly $18-25 across marketplace sellers.
products.provenance: 2mm thickened quartz-glass construction, 40-55 gal rating, and 68-89°F adjustable dial verified via live fetch of ReviewAqua's hands-on review and corroborated by NationalWPSupply's listing (same quartz-glass material and thermostat description). temperature_accuracy_f corrected to null: the review calls the ~1°F a dial increment and explicitly warns the dial 'may not be perfectly accurate,' so no true tolerance is published. shatterproof_guard corrected to null: the 'explosion-proof' claim describes the quartz glass itself, not a physical guard — this bare-glass unit has none. No firm 300W-specific price published, so priceUsd left null.

products.name: Tetra HT30
products.priceNote: ThatPetPlace retail price, verified live 2026-08-16; KensFish lists it at $17.97, a close match.
products.provenance: Fixed, non-adjustable 78°F (±2°F) internal electronic thermostat, HT30 = 100W for 10-30 gal, glass construction with silicon-carbide-crystal heat transfer, and $18.99 price all verified via live fetch of ThatPetPlace; corroborated by Tetra's official HT submersible heaters page and KensFish's $17.97 listing. Primary source was switched from the manufacturer page to the live-verified ThatPetPlace listing so the cited source is confirmed reachable.
